Validate a Restart Pool

Source: R/net.fn.restart_pool.R
validate_restart_pool.Rd

Checks that a restart pool (a directory made by make_restart_pool(), holding a pool_index.csv) can be used by netsim_path_wrapper(). This function is not called by the simulation functions: call it after making a pool, or before starting a long run from it.

Usage

validate_restart_pool(path)

Arguments

path

Path to a restart pool directory, or to a single restart point file.

Value

A data.frame with one row per pool element (invisibly): pool_num, file_path, n_runs, nsteps (the number of time steps kept in the element, 1 for a pool made by make_restart_pool()) and epimodel_version.

Details

Errors are raised when:

  • path is a directory without a pool_index.csv, or its pool_index.csv has no pool_num or epimodel_version column, or does not number the elements 1 to N;

  • an element listed in pool_index.csv has no <pool_num>.rds file;

  • an element is not a single simulation netsim restart point with the elements needed to restart (param, control, nwparam, epi, run, coef.form and num.nw);

  • an element was made with another major.minor version of EpiModel than the one installed, according to pool_index.csv (checked by netsim_path_wrapper() before running) or to the element itself (checked by netsim). Run this function with the EpiModel version the simulations will use (e.g. in the HPC renv);

  • the elements do not all hold the same number of time steps: netsim requires control$start to be that number + 1 for each of them.

Warnings are raised when:

  • the pool directory holds <n>.rds files not listed in pool_index.csv, which are never used;

  • path is a single file holding several simulations: netsim_path_wrapper() restarts every replicate from its first simulation.

See also

make_restart_pool(), netsim_path_wrapper()
